newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Britannic shares may slip to 750p.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Britannic shares may slip to 750p.

text.p: + Britannic Assurance shares are close to completing a bearish double top chart pattern which would send them down to the 725p-750p region, technical analysts said.
+ The shares have been underperforming the All-Share index since March and have fallen below their 50 day moving average signalling their weak state.
+ The shares are in the Mid-250 index.
Shares in Britannic Assurance show signs of faltering and losing all the gains made so far this year, technical analysts said.
"The price chart is tracing out a double-top pattern which indicates a downside risk to the 725p-750p area," said Richard Lake, technical analyst at Brewin Dolphin & Co.
By 0920 GMT, the shares were down 1/2p to 812-1/2p. They started the year at 724p and peaked at 893p in May.
A double-top pattern is one in which a share price initially rises to a peak -- usually on high volume as investors scramble to buy the stock.

Profit-taking then erodes the share price but investors who had missed the original rally plus some who want to add to their holding, buy the stock at lower at a lower level pushing the share price back to around its previous peak.

But there is insufficient buying interest to send the stock to a new high and the shares are knocked back again only this time around buyers fail to appear in sufficient numbers to stop the fall below previous support.
Britannic Assurance shares are now close to testing this neckline support area at 805p but there are indications the shares will not be able to keep their foothold.

Continued erosion of the stock's relative strength against the All-Share index will force the shares below the 805p support level, analysts said noting that Britannia's relative strength line has been weakening since March as the shares have underperformed the index by 10 percent since that time.
And with the shares having fallen below their 50 day moving average, there seems little likelihood of them mounting a comeback over the short-term.
"I would recommend a reduction of holdings," said Lake.
The shares are a constituent of the Mid-250 index of medium-sized companies.
